title: Lusaka Grocery Shop
input: I run a small grocery shop in Lusaka. This week I made K4,500 in sales. I spent K2,700 on stock, K500 on rent, K250 on transport, and K300 on other expenses. I also owe K1,000 to my supplier. Can I afford to take a K3,000 loan?

title: Salon Slow Month
input: I own a salon in Ndola. Last week I made K3,200. I spent K1,100 on products, K900 on rent, K250 on transport, and K400 on other expenses. January has been slow. What should I improve?

title: Farmer Restocking Decision
input: I am a farmer near Kabwe. I made 6800 from produce sales and spent 4200 on inputs and transport. I still owe K1500 and I want to borrow K2000 for the next planting cycle. Is that safe?
